tables.description: Ad accounts you run campaigns for. One row per account.

fields.name: Page ID
fields.description: Facebook page the ads run from

fields.name: Instagram Account ID
fields.description: Optional, for IG placements

fields.name: Pixel ID
fields.description: Required for conversion campaigns

tables.description: Ad campaigns to launch via the Meta Marketing API.

fields.name: Interests
fields.description: Comma-separated interest names; resolved to IDs via Targeting Search.

fields.name: Pixel Event
fields.description: Required for OUTCOME_SALES / OUTCOME_LEADS. The standard Meta event to optimize for.

fields.name: Creative Image
fields.description: Image creative (use this OR Video URL)

fields.name: Video URL
fields.description: Public URL to a video file (use this OR Creative Image)

fields.name: Campaign ID
fields.description: Written by script after launch

fields.name: Ad Set ID
fields.description: Written by script after launch

fields.name: Ad ID
fields.description: Written by script after launch

fields.name: Launch Log
fields.description: Errors / status messages from the launch script

tables.description: Daily ad performance from Meta Insights API. One row per ad per day. Upserted by pull_insights.py via the Record Key field (format: {ad_id}_{YYYY-MM-DD}).

fields.name: Record Key
fields.description: Upsert key: {ad_id}_{YYYY-MM-DD}

fields.name: Ad ID
fields.description: Meta ad ID

fields.name: CTR
fields.description: Click-through rate (decimal, e.g. 0.0125 = 1.25%)

fields.name: Results
fields.description: Count of the campaign's optimization event (leads, purchases, etc.)

fields.name: Conversion Value
fields.description: Revenue attributed by Meta (purchases/leads value)

tables.description: Per-variant image generation briefs. One row per ad image. Templates (Style A/B scaffolds) live in repo at letsgosite_ads/campaigns/ai_briefs/_template_*.md. Designer/AI generates candidates → attaches to Candidates field → owner picks winner → links to Campaign for launch.

fields.name: Slug
fields.description: Unique slug like 'solo_pixel_a'. Matches UTM ad parameter.

fields.name: Angle
fields.description: Short label for the creative angle, e.g. 'pixel tracking', 'missed calls', 'credibility'.

fields.name: Hero Lines
fields.description: The big top-of-poster text. Line breaks preserved.

fields.name: Price
fields.description: e.g. '$29/mo'. Always largest element in Style A.

fields.name: Sub-features
fields.description: Max 3 lines, one per bullet.

fields.name: Footer Path
fields.description: e.g. '/solo', '/lite', '/reserve-pro'.

fields.name: Header Eyebrow
fields.description: Optional top-line text, e.g. 'FOUNDING — FIRST 25 ONLY'.

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: Style B only: who is holding the paper.

fields.name: Setting
fields.description: Style B only: location, lighting, time of day.

fields.name: Paper Type
fields.description: Style B only: white printer / legal pad / cardboard / etc.

fields.name: Lettering Style
fields.description: Style B only: 'hand-lettered Sharpie' or 'printed'.

fields.name: Paper Text
fields.description: Style B only: exact verbatim text rendered on the paper.

fields.name: Pose Detail
fields.description: Style B only: hand position, gaze, paper angle.

fields.name: Full Prompt
fields.description: The exact paragraph to paste into Flux 1.1 Pro / Imagen 3.

fields.name: Candidates to Generate
fields.description: Style A: ~4. Style B: ~6 (lower yield).

fields.name: Candidates
fields.description: All generated candidates. Designer attaches here.

fields.name: Winner 1:1
fields.description: The picked 1080x1080 image.

fields.name: Winner 9:16
fields.description: The picked 1080x1920 image.

fields.name: Campaign
fields.description: Once launched, link to the Campaign row.
